description: DMAP AI helps users analyze drought conditions for a selected location and time period. It returns SPI tables, drought severity events, wavelet scalogram summaries, and drought periodicity diagnostics using NASA POWER or ERA5 data. Copula and paid workflows are not included in this ChatGPT version.

defaultPrompt: Analyze the historical SPI for Ames, Iowa, from 1981 to 2024 using NASA POWER.
Identify historical drought events for a selected location, including duration, magnitude, and minimum SPI.
Analyze historical drought periodicity for a selected location using the wavelet scalogram and global wavelet spectrum.
